reason: Fifty bucks for a bottle isn't the issue for me. But nothing here tells me what the filter actually takes out, and I'm not signing up for a filter subscription on a creator's say-so. I already have a bottle I like on my desk, so this would have to be clearly better looking and proven to work.
objection: How do I know the filter actually does anything? 'Up to 150 L' from the supplier isn't a lab test, and I'd basically be paying a subscription for a mystery cartridge.
would_change_my_mind: Independent lab results showing what the filter removes, plus seeing the bottle in person or in real unfiltered photos so I know it actually looks good on my desk.
